name: Aki no Urara no ~Akaneiro Shoutengai~
original_name: 秋のうららの～あかね色商店街～
source:
Kousuke lives in an old apartment alone since his divorced mother is abroad on business. One day, two transfer girls join his class. Actually, they are his new sisters because his mother gets remarried. His new father is unreliable, and he is an easy prey for swindlers. They are on honeymoon now, and he can't get in contact with them. Also, he finds out that his new father borrows money from his apartment owner, and the owner tries to kick him out. Finally, the owner lets him to pay in installments, and he starts to live with his new sisters. One day, he falls in love with a girl....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090415125925/http://web.archive.org/web/20090415125925/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008473]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
孝介独自住在一间旧公寓里，因为离异的母亲在国外出差。某天，两位转学生来到了他的班级。实际上，她们是他母亲再婚后的新姐妹。他的新父亲很不靠谱，是骗子的易受骗对象。他们现在在度蜜月，他无法联系到他们。而且，他发现新父亲向公寓房东借了钱，房东试图把他赶出去。最终，房东同意让他分期付款，他开始和新姐妹们一起生活。某天，他爱上了一个女孩……
